rows.label: bayer(4) is the classic ordered-dither matrix; bayer(8) holds 0..63 once each
duotone: black -> dark, white -> light, mid grey -> the midpoint; contrast 3 clamps a 0.3 grey to dark
duotone .cube (33^3) matches the JS reference within 0.00 levels (swapped colours = white line art on accent)
threshold1bit: dither none is a hard step at the threshold; bayer4 / bayer8 cover a flat grey with exactly its level (0.25 -> 4/16, 0.5 -> 32/64)
dither cell scales with H (cell 2 @1080 = 1 px @540) and the SVG filter is synchronous (feFlood + feTile, no feImage / href)
bad dither and a threshold .cube are refused
gridTunnel + dotGrid: the same t draws the same calls in any order (no history, no clock)
gridTunnel drift moves the rings (t 0.3 != 0.7) and repeats after one ring period (t 0 == t 1/drift); drift 0 is still
dotGrid is static without drift, moves with drift; both kinds mount through overlay.js (ALL_KINDS)
duotone accent -> paper: SVG filter (DOM) vs JS reference: mean 0.72 levels, 0.00% pixels off by > 24
duotone swapped: light lines on accent: SVG filter (DOM) vs JS reference: mean 0.93 levels, 0.00% pixels off by > 24
threshold1bit dither none: SVG filter (DOM) vs JS reference: mean 0.00 levels, 0.00% pixels off by > 24
threshold1bit bayer4: SVG filter (DOM) vs JS reference: mean 0.14 levels, 0.06% pixels off by > 24
threshold1bit bayer8 cell 4 on accent: SVG filter (DOM) vs JS reference: mean 0.50 levels, 0.07% pixels off by > 24
a look on an empty (transparent or hidden) layer paints nothing: the Bayer tile never leaks outside the source coverage
gridTunnel (accent on paper): mounted via mountStack (gridTunnel), bit-identical at t 1.3 after rendering t 3.7
gridTunnel reversed, off-centre vp: mounted via mountStack (gridTunnel), bit-identical at t 1.3 after rendering t 3.7
dotGrid glow + clear hole: mounted via mountStack (dotGrid), bit-identical at t 1.3 after rendering t 3.7
dotGrid reversed: mounted via mountStack (dotGrid), bit-identical at t 1.3 after rendering t 3.7
